conviction_note: Near-zero: the company's own H1 plan needs only 28.4bn yen of Q2 operating profit against 31.0bn for the two companies' combined Jun-Aug 2025 quarter, with Q1 already about 2.5bn ahead, so an H1 beat of plan is likely. But the street's FY ordinary-profit figure (100.6bn) already sits above the company's 98.1bn, Q2 same-store sales (+0.7% average) are public and weak, and Jun-Aug peer prints are split. The findings sum to +0.2 and the scaled number is (2*0.53-1)*3.0 = +0.18. The two agree in sign and size.

FY ordinary-profit consensus is 100,613m yen against the company's 98,100m (kabuyoho, https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=3391). positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-09-29: no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, so short_ratio is 0.0 with no change (a real zero, truncated). 信用倍率 7.85 (scraped): leveraged retail is crowded long, so there is no squeeze fuel and there is overhang on a disappointment. findings.finding: The company's H1 plan (OP 52.6bn) less Q1 actual (24.2bn) leaves 28.4bn of Q2 operating profit needed. The two companies' combined Jun-Aug 2025 quarter made 31.0bn (Tsuruha 15.98bn plus Welcia 15.00bn), and Q1 ran +19.5% against its combined prior-year figure (24.2bn vs 20.3bn), so the plan implies Q2 down about 8% year on year. Fisco says Q1 also beat the company's internal plan by 2-3bn. An H1 beat of the company plan is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 (2026-07-08 15:30): OP 24.2bn vs about 20.5bn consensus and above the internal plan, FY held. Stock +2.88% close to close (Yahoo chart; kabutan/Fisco '大幅反発'). Other measured close-to-close print reactions: +2.11, +0.49, +1.77, -2.79, -3.22.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Consensus FY ordinary profit (100.6bn) is already 2.6% above the plan, so the street expects outperformance. What is less visible is the size of the Q2 cushion, because the year-earlier comparison has to be rebuilt from two separate companies' filings. If it were fully priced, the stock would not have fallen 7% into the print, though that fall roughly matches the sector's.
findings.independence: Kabutan quarterly tables give the year-earlier quarters for both companies (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3391&mode=k and https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3141&mode=k). Fisco on the internal-plan beat: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3391&b=n202607090602. Kusuri no Aoki's Jun-Aug gross-margin rise (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3549&b=n202610020882) points the same way for the industry.

findings.finding: Group same-store sales slowed sharply in Q2: June -1.1% (物販 -3.8%, customers -4.2%), July +1.7% (物販 flat), August +1.5% (物販 +0.3%, customers -2.0%). That is about +0.7% for the quarter against April's +5.0%, so gross profit gets less help from the top line than in Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured case of this name reacting to an SSS slowdown at the print. Q1 had strong SSS and the stock rose 2.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The monthly series has been public since late July to late September, and the 20-day drawdown may hold it. Kept small for that reason.
findings.independence: June and July figures: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s072971.html and https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s083171.html (same publisher and series).

findings.finding: Jun-Aug results from peers that reported before this print are split, and the weak ones sit in Tsuruha's home regions. Satudora (Hokkaido) swung to a Q1 ordinary loss. Yakuodo (Tohoku) had Jun-Aug ordinary profit down 10.1% and missed its own H1 plan. Create SD had OP down 4.1% with a lower gross margin and fell sharply. Kusuri no Aoki had OP up 16% with a higher gross margin and hit limit-up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Tsuruha closed -1.7% on 2026-10-02, the day Aoki went limit-up, and +3.3% on 10-05; a peer-to-Tsuruha transmission is not established.
findings.why_not_priced: These are proxies and are public. Tsuruha's merger synergies (shared buying, SG&A) are its own driver, so transmission is weak. Hokkaido and Tohoku hold about 22% of its stores (1,248 of 5,665), so the weak northern peers are the relevant ones. Sized small.

findings.finding: The street's FY ordinary-profit figure (100,613m yen) sits 2.6% above the company's unchanged 98,100m. A beat-and-hold at H1, the common Japanese pattern, leaves the guide below the street rather than giving the relief of a raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q1 the FY was held with consensus below the plan and the stock rose 2.9%. Jan 2026 Q3 (-2.79%) and April 2026 FY guide (-3.22%) were both sold, but those periods were merger-distorted.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus is itself the price. What is unknown is the company's revision decision. There is no 業績予想の修正 on TDnet since Q1 (kabutan disclosure list), so nothing has been pre-released. Kept near zero because a raise to about 100bn is about as likely as a hold.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed. Street FY ordinary 100.6bn vs plan 98.1bn, so a raise to about 100bn is in line and a hold is a mild disappointment; about a coin flip. Returns: interim dividend of 24 yen expected unchanged; no buyback signal. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter: the H1 plan needs Q2 OP of 28.4bn against 31.0bn for the two companies combined a year earlier; Q1 progress was 47.0% of H1 ordinary profit vs 45.3% a year earlier (kabutan), so the plan looks beatable.

baseline_tension: The findings net slightly positive (+0.2) against a slightly negative priced lean (-0.084) and a -7.25% 20-day run-up that mostly tracks the sector. The strongest positive the release could carry is an H1 beat plus a FY raise to the street's 100bn or above; I looked for it, and the arithmetic supports the H1 beat but not a sourced raise. The negatives rest on public monthly data and peer proxies, so they are kept small.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative on a public monthly series moves p_up toward 50): the Q2 same-store sales finding was cut from -0.4 to -0.2, since the 月次 have been public since July to September

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): three of the four draft findings were negative, so I rechecked the sign of the FY-consensus finding. A beat-and-hold with the street above plan is at most mildly negative, so it went from -0.2 to -0.1; the strongest positive (H1 beat plus FY raise) is named in baseline_tension
Net: the draft sum of -0.1 became +0.2, and p_up went from 52 to 53. abs_move_pct (3.0) and the peer-proxy finding were unchanged
